paragraphs: Juggalo Championship Wrestling was founded by the Insane Clown Posse, with the first bell ringing December 19, 1999 at St. Andrew's Hall in Detroit.

Today JCW runs weekly — Lunacy streams every Thursday at 7PM Eastern on the Psychopathic Records YouTube channel, free for the whole world, with the biggest supershows landing at the Gathering of the Juggalos.
No ads sold on your data. No tracking. Made for the family, 13 and up.
